about_the_game: This is a three consumption plus management game, where juice is extracted and then sold. By providing timely customer service, customers can earn coins and goodwill in order to successfully reach a five-star juice store. Accumulating coins can unlock upgraded devices and fruit varieties. We hope everyone can enjoy the joy of the game in a relaxed atmosphere.
